an4.191:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sotānudhatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ vacasā paricitānaṃ manasānupekkhitānaṃ diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ cattāro ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
an4.191:1.4: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.191:1.5: tassa te dhammā sotānudhatā honti vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā. diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an4.191:1.6: so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati.
an4.191:1.9: atha so satto khippaṃ yeva visesagāmī hoti.
an4.191:1.10: sotānugatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ vacasā paricitānaṃ manasānupekkhitānaṃ diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ ayaṃ paṭhamo ānisaṃso pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.191:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti :
an4.191:2.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.191:2.3: tassa te dhammā sotānudhatā honti vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an4.191:2.4: so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati.
an4.191:2.5: tassa tattha na heva kho sukhino dhammapadāpilapanti.
an4.191:2.6: api ca kho bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
an4.191:2.8: ayaṃ vā so dhammavinayo yatthāhaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acari’nti.
an4.191:2.10: atha so satto khippaṃ yeva visesagāmī hoti.
an4.191:2.13: tassa naheva kho assa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā
an4.191:2.14: bherisaddo nu kho na nu kho bherisaddoti.
an4.191:2.16: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti :
an4.191:2.17: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.191:2.18: tassa te dhammā sotānudhatā honti. vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an4.191:2.19: so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati.
an4.191:2.20: tassa tattha naheva kho sukhino dhammapadāpilapanti.
an4.191:2.21: api ca kho bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
an4.191:2.23: ayaṃ vā so dhammavinayo yatthāhaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarinti.
an4.191:2.25: atha so satto khippaṃ yeva visesagāmī hoti.
an4.191:2.26: sotānudhatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ vacasā paricitānaṃ manasānupekkhitānaṃ diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ ayaṃ dutiyo ānisaṃso pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.191:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti :
an4.191:3.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.191:3.3: tassa te dhammā sotānudhatā honti vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an4.191:3.4: so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati.
an4.191:3.5: tassa tattha na heva kho sukhino dhammapadāpilapanti. napi bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
an4.191:3.6: api ca kho devaputto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
an4.191:3.8: ayaṃ vā so dhammavinayo yatthāhaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarinti.
an4.191:3.10: atha so satto khippaṃyeva visesagāmī hoti.

an4.191:3.14: saṅkhasaddo nu kho na nu kho saṅkhasaddoti.
an4.191:3.16: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti :
an4.191:3.17: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.191:3.18: tassa te dhammā sotānudhatā honti vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an4.191:3.19: so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati.
an4.191:3.20: tassa tattha na heva kho sukhino dhammapadāpilapanti. na pi bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti,
an4.191:3.21: api ca kho devaputto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
an4.191:3.23: ayaṃ vā so dhammavinayo yatthāhaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarinti.
an4.191:3.25: atha so satto khippaṃ yeva visesagāmī hoti.
an4.191:3.26: sotānudhatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ vacasā paricitānaṃ manasānupekkhitānaṃ diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ ayaṃ tatiyo ānisaṃso pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.191:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti :
an4.191:4.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.191:4.3: tassa te dhammā sotānudhatā honti vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an4.191:4.4: so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ deva nikāyaṃ upapajjati.
an4.191:4.5: tassa tattha na heva kho sukhino dhammapadāpilapanti. na pi bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti, napi devaputto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
an4.191:4.6: api ca kho opapātiko opapātikaṃ sāreti :
an4.191:4.7: sarasi tvaṃ mārisa yattha mayaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarimhāti.
an4.191:4.11: atha so satto khippaṃ yeva visesagāmī hoti.
an4.191:4.17: sarāmi samma. idampi samma sarasīti. so evaṃ vadeyya: sarāmi sammāti.
an4.191:4.18: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti :
an4.191:4.19: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.191:4.20: tassa te dhammā sotānudhatā honti vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an4.191:4.21: so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati.
an4.191:4.22: tassa tattha sukhino dhammapadāpilapanti. napi bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. napi devaputto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
an4.191:4.23: api ca kho opapātiko opapātikaṃ sāreti :
an4.191:4.24: sarasi tvaṃ mārisa, yattha mayaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarimhāti.
an4.191:4.28: atha kho so satto khippaṃyeva visesagāmī hoti.
an4.191:4.29: sotānudhatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ vacasā paricitānaṃ manasānupekkhitānaṃ diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ ayaṃ catuttho ānisaṃso pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.191:4.30: sotānudhatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ vacasā paricitānaṃ manasānupekkhitānaṃ diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ ime cattāro ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhāti.
